access: Use the bounded local reader. It performs no fetch. A shallow clone missing objects must explicitly fetch the recorded source revision or use the official connector at that revision.
object_retention: Keep the recorded source revision and blobs reachable during any separately authorized future history rewrite; do not silently substitute rewritten text.
relative_reference_rule: Resolve original relative paths from docs/, not from this manifest directory. Use the immutable permalink for rendered original links.
scope: Immutable published originals. Historical progress is provenance; affected studies retain every non-superseded access/retry/account constraint. Current user instructions, AGENTS and exact canonical contracts control. Archiving creates no authority.
